text:
Maya: FYI onboarding Navis13b (int4) is showing intermittent OOMs under long-context streaming (>6k tokens). Happens after ~30m sustained load, fragmentation climbs then cudaMalloc fails.
Maya: Paste from one run:
```
[2026-03-20T15:12:08Z] ERROR OOM: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-20T15:12:08Z] heap: total=31.9G free=2.1G largest_free=850M
[2026-03-20T15:12:08Z] kv_cache: 12.4G used, prefetch=2.1G
[2026-03-20T15:12:08Z] evict: tried=3 freed=0
```
Maya: Evictions not reclaiming useful contiguous space, looks like tiny free fragments. Prefetch on by default for this build.
Oliver: Short-term: turn off prefetch on canary and reduce model default max_new_tokens 1024->256. Also add soft_reserve=0.18 and smaller batch_window_ms. Roll to 5% first.
Oliver: Runtime snippet for rollout:
```yaml
model_overrides:
  navis13b-int4:
    prefetch: false
    max_new_tokens_default: 256
    soft_reserve: 0.18
    batch_window_ms: 8
```
Jamal: Add deterministic eviction params: kv_eviction_trigger_ratio=0.65 and kv_trim_granularity=64MB. Increase slab_alignment to 256KB to reduce small-chunk fragmentation.
Jamal: Will kick off stress job (30m, 8k context) on canary nodes to exercise allocator. ETA ~2h.
Maya: Note on quality: dropping default to 256 impacts long-dialog convo-completion eval (approx -1.7% F1). We'll A/B route only noise/low-risk traffic and keep evaluation flows at 512 via prompt-level override.
devex-bot: Evals queued: https://internal.redwood/evals/rounds/2026-03-20/navis13b-canary (conv-completion, qa-long).
infra-bot: deploy 83421 started: canary update navis13b-int4 -> prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=256 (5% traffic).
Oliver: If fragmentation persists after alignment/trim, next steps: try jemalloc-slab allocator or re-export quant with padding-aligned tensors. Also consider prefetch_backoff (start 0.1 -> 1.0) ramped by mem pressure rather than full disable.
Maya: I'll push prompt overrides for eval routes to preserve 512 tokens. Jamal -> infra tweaks + defrag stress; Oliver -> rollout and rollback playbook. Will reconvene with results. :thumbsup:
